info.name: Traveler's Guide to Elysia
info.description: Living Wood race for Aurora Builder.
info.author: Michael

description.p: Living Wood are sentient plantfolk deliberately created by druidic circles to serve as companions, assistants, and guardians of the natural world. Through ancient rites blending druidic magic with living timber, these beings are grown rather than born—shaped with emotions, cognition, and moral reasoning comparable to humanoids. This design is intentional. Living Wood are not tools, but caretakers meant to act with judgment in both peace and crisis.
They are neither constructs nor mindless plants. Living Wood are alive, aware, and capable of choice—crafted to endure where others pass on.

Most Living Wood adhere to Lawful Neutral or Lawful Good philosophies, reflecting the values of the druidic circles that created them. Their sense of law is rooted not in written codes, but in consistency, responsibility, and preservation. They value balance over dominance and continuity over ambition.

Though often calm and patient, Living Wood are not emotionless. They experience attachment, pride, frustration, and grief, tempered by an understanding that nature unfolds across long spans of time. Some struggle when separated from their original purpose, while others adapt, finding new duties beyond the groves that shaped them.
All Living Wood are created through ritual, but not all are created equal.

New Wood are formed from younger or more modest trees. They are typically Medium in size, more mobile, and more adaptable to life beyond druidic groves. New Wood are often entrusted with patrol, travel, and assisting druids directly.

Old Wood are created using ancient, massive trees—those that have stood for centuries or longer. These Living Wood emerge Large in stature from the moment of their creation, bearing the weight, density, and presence of their source. Old Wood are commonly tasked with guarding sacred sites, ancient boundaries, or places of deep natural significance.
This distinction reflects the materials and intent of their creation, not rank or superiority.
Your Living Wood character has the following racial traits.
Ability Score Increase. Increase one ability score of your choice by 2.
Creature Type. You are a Plant.
Size. You are Medium or Large, your choice. For narrative and mechanical purposes, Medium Living Wood are referred to as New Wood, and Large Living Wood are referred to as Old Wood.
Speed. Your walking speed is 30 feet if you are Medium. Your walking speed is 20 feet if you are Large.
Age. Living Wood typically live between 100 and 150 years.
Languages. You can speak, read, and write Common and Druidic.
Skill Proficiency. You gain proficiency in either Survival, Animal Handling, Nature, or History.
Wooden Frame. While you are not wearing armor, your Armor Class equals 10 + your Constitution modifier. You can still benefit from a shield.
Rooted Awareness. While you are in contact with the ground, you have tremorsense out to a range of 30 feet.
Barkbound Resilience. You have resistance to nonmagical bludgeoning damage.

Grasping Limbs. When you successfully grapple a creature smaller than you, you can choose to restrain it instead. The restrained creature can use its action to attempt to escape, following the normal rules for ending a grapple.

As a natural consequence of their size and structure, Old Wood possess greater physical reach. This is not the result of training or aggression, but of scale. Old Wood do not move quickly, but they occupy space with the inevitability of trees—difficult to ignore and harder to displace. When an Old Wood moves, it is because something significant demands their attention.
